video_title: EXCLUSIVE: Walker Kessler on Luka's Court Vision - Mason & Ireland at Lakers Media Day

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on building chemistry with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: to hit the ground running on our chemistry is going to be really important this season.

text_blocks.speaker: Ireland
text_blocks.text: Are you starting to feel like there's some chemistry developing?

text_blocks.speaker: Walker Kessler
text_blocks.text: No question. I think starting with the Slovenia trip and just spending this time together in LA, playing pickup, I mean we've known each other for probably six weeks now and training camp hasn't even started. So to hit the ground running on our chemistry is going to be really important this season.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on Luka Doncic's elite court vision
quotes.excerpt: his court vision is unreal. There are so many times where I'll be near the basket.

text_blocks.speaker: Mason
text_blocks.text: Have you noticed anything about playing with Luka that maybe you didn't notice when you were playing against him?

text_blocks.speaker: Walker Kessler
text_blocks.text: You got to be ready to catch a ball no matter where you are on the floor. His court vision is unreal. There are so many times where I'll be near the basket and I'm like, he doesn't see me. I'm not, and then all of a sudden he'll just look this way and just throw it the other way and the ball will be right there. I'm basically touching the ball and it's going in.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on defending elite centers like Nikola Jokic and Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: you just try to make it as difficult as possible for them the whole night.

text_blocks.speaker: Ireland
text_blocks.text: You're going to run into some other centers, guys like Jokic and guys like Wemby. Tell me about how you get ready for those matchups and how do you defend Wemby?

text_blocks.speaker: Walker Kessler
text_blocks.text: Wemby is obviously a generational player, super talented, extremely hard worker, very skilled. I think guys like that, you just try to make it as difficult as possible for them the whole night. It's a long night and just getting scored on once or twice doesn't mean that you're not going to stop a couple shots and make it tougher or just expend their energy. So just making it as difficult as possible.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on the value of Kevon Looney as a veteran teammate
quotes.excerpt: he's done it before. He's fantastic. Obviously on the court, unbelievable competitor, unbelievable rebounder.

text_blocks.speaker: Mason
text_blocks.text: Does it help you that you got a veteran, a guy with a few rings in Kevon Looney?

text_blocks.speaker: Walker Kessler
text_blocks.text: He's done it before. He's fantastic. Obviously on the court, unbelievable competitor, unbelievable rebounder. Has done it before, the championship level. But off the court, unbelievable person as well. So just being around that is going to be really important to our success.
